content: KABCO will connect farmers with domestic and international buyers, identify market opportunities, negotiate trade agreements, and organize buyer-seller meets to maximize returns. They will conduct training programs and workshops on modern farming techniques, quality control, and export procedures to enhance participants’ skills and knowledge. KABCO will guide participants through certification processes like Global GAP, organic certification, and HACCP to meet international market standards. They will earn a commission on produce sales by negotiating competitive prices and managing the supply chain efficiently. KABCO will also develop hi-tech agricultural farms, engage farmer groups through Service Level Agreements, and ensure regulatory compliance while providing administrative and technical support to streamline farming activities.
